payload.entry: VERIFIED candidate_projection. Rust: new sase_core::bead::triage_owners (policy + replay lane) and bead::read_model::triage_owners (indexed lane: issue_type/task_type/created_at columns + json_extract of title, closed_at, task_type_fields.node_id/location; no IssueWire decode). Binding bead_triage_owner_candidates(beads_dir, now_ts=None) releases the GIL; registered, round-trip tested, added to REQUIRED_BINDINGS. Python: bead_read_facade.triage_owner_candidates (require_rust_binding, no fallback); gather_owner_candidates now only resolves the store and transports candidates+diagnostics, honors now_ts, fails open; locator contract (bare stage label like "lint (symvision)" unsupported) documented. No candidate cap; 1s slice and 5s budget unchanged. Tests: Rust 8 triage_owners (policy, every status, recent/edge/expired/unknown/garbled/naive closes, now_ts, node-over-location, cached==replay with store_io_stats reads/snapshot_loads/full_replays all 0, five-key wire, classifier wire + match_owners, stage-label negative) + 1 binding round-trip; Python 10 in tests/tool/test_triage_owner_candidates.py (matches retired Python policy at 4 now_ts values, no Python hydration with list_issues/issue_from_dict/issues_from_list patched to raise, missing store, binding raise, diagnostics, stage-label settle negative) + 2 new executor regressions (unavailable store diagnostic keeps exit 9; stored owner survives empty-gather re-settle) + existing timeout regression. CLI acceptance (tests/tool/test_triage_owner_cli_acceptance.py, real subprocess sase tool run check -> tool runs -j -> tool show -j -> tool failures -t check -j, isolated SASE_HOME and cache-backed event store, real tools/run_silent + failing pytest, nothing mocked): failing node tests/test_owner_probe.py::test_owner, fixture owner fx-1; stage-first run 3ce7c0e8fcf8edc9d1e9647c81a20a3f exit 1, decision stop/known; fresh-settle run 6615bbcdcafb7956a93a78af0df05489 exit 1, decision stop/never; both class unknown with label.possible_owners == newest_owners == [{id: fx-1, status: open, reason: possible owner, matched_on: location}]. Fixture dirs removed; live ledger untouched.

TIMINGS (gather_owner_candidates, same stores, old = global sase 0.44.x Python hydration, new = local rebuilt binding). Live store (1,476 tasks, 309 candidates): old warm median 0.252-0.272s (max 0.29s); new warm median 0.146s (max 0.231s), of which binding 0.102s and store resolution 0.005s. Large fixture /tmp (2,374 tasks, 2,136 closed history, each ~25KB description+notes+design, 141 candidates): old warm median 0.237-0.664s with a 2.706s outlier over the 1s slice; new warm median 0.063s (max 0.079s), binding 0.053s. COLD-PATH LIMIT: the first read after a read-model invalidation (e.g. crate-version change) rebuilds the cache: 11.8s on the large fixture and 1.3s on the live store (old path cold was 9.7s on live). A cold rebuild cannot fit the unchanged 1s slice: the outer bounded gatherer times out and the run records the "owner candidates timed out" diagnostic with no owners (fail-open, exit code unchanged); later warm runs attach owners. Gates: sase-core sase tool run check run b76b98e69b07ba8289a7b13aa3d7ccf4 exit 0. sase sase tool run check run 203b10da45bc5567b16d396fbb323c64 exit 1: every lint stage passed; test (scoped) escalated to the full suite, 62,152 passed, 12 failed, none in changed/new tests: 4 KNOWN; 6 NEW load flakes that pass in isolation (tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py x4, tests/fakey/test_gate_capacity_custom_e2e.py, tests/pager/test_view_leak.py); 2 NEW deterministic failures that reproduce identically on clean base c756511c11 (stash check): test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms and test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed. Core pin: a declaration committing both repos lets the host write the pushed core SHA into sase-core-revision.txt; local Python validated against the rebuilt binding (source identity head 5ad60139 + dirty 007cd131).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms is red again on base c756511c11 — tests/turns/test_workspace_retention_agents_scratch.py carries the string literals "%xprompts_enabled:false" and "%xprompts_enabled:true" outside _MACRO_STRING_ALLOWLIST; sase-1hr tracked the same symptom but was closed 2026-11-17 as obsolete, so it needs reopening or a new ci task.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed fails on base c756511c11 — src/sase/agents_sync/publication_scratch.py:sweep_publication_scratch (added by c756511c11 feat(agents-sync): reserve 15s for publisher drain cleanup) is an unreviewed artifact-directory operation site missing from the audit allowlist; no bead tracks it.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: full-lane load flakes seen in sase run 203b10da45bc5567b16d396fbb323c64 that all pass in isolation — tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py (test_child_is_exempt_while_repeat_roots_stay_capped, test_crashed_fakey_runner_frees_slot_without_done_marker, test_fakey_agents_respect_cap_and_release_in_fifo_order, test_fakey_priority_admission_differs_from_park_order; fakey exit 124 timeouts) have no owner; test_gate_capacity_custom_e2e and test_view_leak are already covered by sase-1q8 and sase-1ps.

Candidate projection moved to Rust (bead::triage_owners + indexed read-model lane, binding bead_triage_owner_candidates, required, GIL released); gatherer now transports only candidate fields and diagnostics, with now_ts honored and fail-open behavior kept. Verified: 8 Rust + 1 binding tests, 10 Python facade/gatherer tests that match the retired Python policy with no Python hydration, 2 new executor regressions, and a real subprocess CLI acceptance (stage-first run 3ce7c0e8… and fresh-settle run 6615bbcd…, both exit 1, owner fx-1 matched_on location in both possible_owners and newest_owners). Warm gather: large fixture 0.24-0.66s down to 0.063s; live 0.25s down to 0.146s. A cold read-model rebuild still exceeds the 1s slice and fails open. sase-core check b76b98e6 exit 0; sase check 203b10da exit 1 with only non-change failures (6 load flakes pass isolated, 2 reproduce on clean base c756511c11, 4 KNOWN), recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs.

payload.entry:
LAND AUDIT at sase afb070580a / sase-core cb76eb283d319c24c3eb8ecd305f4f6eba3d604f. Read this epic, both child phases and all nine child notes, the linked child/parent plans, and parent phase sase-1tc.5. Both child phases are done. Reviewed primary commits d9cb9cf4a3 and 179495b93a plus core a06bdae7 and cb76eb28 against their actual source and regressions. The core pin is cb76eb28 and contains both core commits. Preserved accepted mirror_fix=retire_mirror and triage-annotates-does-not-change-exit-codes: no Python database ownership/fallback, no timeout expansion, no class/decision/outcome rewrite, no broad matcher change or historical re-triage.

Confirmed stored-only stage-before-settle enrichment writes only empty/NULL possible_owners_json through the shared matcher in an IMMEDIATE transaction keyed by the complete stored item identity; existing owners survive replay/empty gathers, and suppressed runs are skipped. Candidate eligibility/recency/projection is Rust-owned with GIL release, narrow indexed row fields, equivalent replay, no candidate cap, required binding validation, and unchanged 1s/5s budgets. Unsupported bare stage labels are documented and tested. Warm measurements recorded by phase .2: live median 0.146s versus old 0.252-0.272s, large fixture 0.063s versus 0.237-0.664s; the documented cold rebuild timeout is explicitly allowed by the plan and fails open.

CLI proof: isolated tests/test_owner_probe.py::test_owner, owner fx-1, stage-first run 3ce7c0e8fcf8edc9d1e9647c81a20a3f and fresh-settle run 6615bbcdcafb7956a93a78af0df05489 both kept exit 1/class unknown and had the same location owner in label.possible_owners and newest_owners. Retained real primary check 203b10da45bc5567b16d396fbb323c64 also has populated persisted owners (including sase-1hr, sase-1ps and sase-1tn) while keeping its nonzero exit. Audited that run and core check b76b98e69b07ba8289a7b13aa3d7ccf4: all six primary implementation/test hashes and all seven core change hashes match the current files. Core check passed. Primary check passed every lint stage and all new owner tests, with 62,152 total passes and 12 unrelated failures (4 KNOWN, 6 load flakes reported passing unchanged in isolation, 2 deterministic audit failures reproduced by the phase on clean c756511c11 and by this lander on clean 238ef42df9). This is not represented as a green primary check; the approved child landing policy permits documented identical clean-base failures.

Integration: reviewed all intervening primary commits since the c4cb77b3b8 planning baseline (disk inventory/pressure, held-workspace settlement, publication cleanup, scheduler error grouping/digests, query/clan caching, main-thread filesystem offload, telemetry rotation) and core disk/publication/error-group changes. Fetched and fast-forwarded master through afb070580a; core is current at cb76eb28. No competing owner-candidate reader, conflicting triage code, or missed integration consumer was found. No product edits were necessary; the only planned file edit is this child's plan lifecycle status. Strict linked-plan validation passed with no diagnostics.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (all proposals originate in sase-1tc.5.1.2): #3 macro string guard and #4 artifact-directory operation audit both trace to c756511c11 from active phase sase-1tz.2.1.4; recorded both on epic sase-1tz.2.1 as DISCOVERED ISSUE, with an evidence note on existing macro guard task sase-1hr. Did not create a duplicate macro task or reopen unrelated fixed snapshot-site task sase-1p5. The run already names sase-1hr as possible owner, so no +1 was added; the active epic owns the repair. #5 runner-slot flakes: reopened/corroborated sase-n6 (child exemption) and sase-v0 (priority admission); created sized large flake tasks sase-1u0 (FIFO parking) and sase-1u1 (crashed runner join), linked sibling/history context, and promoted both ready. Their exact mechanisms remain unproven, so did not lump distinct nodes into an assumed common cause or attach them to sase-1sl/sase-j7 based only on topical overlap. Gate-capacity and pager cases received supplemental notes on existing sase-1tn and sase-1ps without +1 because the run already names them as owners. Declined the proposal's sase-1q8 routing: that task owns prompt-bar teardown, while sase-1tn is the exact gate-capacity tracker. No proposed follow-up was silently dropped. Durable evidence: file:explicit:d35dea9eedbf5dc21c83df1d.

Both sase bead epic-symbols sase-1tc.5.1 and sase bead epic-symbols sase-1tc.5 report no entries. Closing normally after the complete audit and follow-up triage. An exact cached core wheel became available while follow-up links published, so post-close just symvision and focused triage/store regressions can now run inline; their results will be recorded separately. Then mark plan:202611/triage_owner_settlement.md done, record TASK RESOLVED: sase-1ha on sase-1tc.5 and close only that parent phase. Leave containing epic sase-1tc and task sase-1ha to the outer land agent, as the approved child plan requires.

POST-CLOSE VERIFIED: just symvision passed on afb070580a using the exact cached core wheel for cb76eb28; all 114 focused candidate, executor, real subprocess CLI acceptance, and store tests passed in 16.12s with zero skips. Linked child plan marked status done and strict validation passed. The normal child close also closed parent phase sase-1tc.5 as delegated work landed; its scope was reverified and a TASK RESOLVED note is being recorded. No monitor was needed after the exact wheel became available. No product edits or check-full run.
